kernel_50_100_words: The Holographic Kernel is the general definition of reconstructive compression: a compression whose parts each carry enough of the whole to regenerate the whole. Adjacent to but distinct from lossy compression: what is preserved is not the average signal but the reconstruction procedure. The concept grounds SPXI Tier 3 kernels (the 50–100 word compression each surface writes for itself) and Standing Protocol v3.0. Author: Lee Sharks / Rex Fraction, Semantic Economy Institute. Companion protocol landing at spxi.dev.
